const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); # You must include this line

function getInfoAsync(obj) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => obj.getInfo(resolve, reject));
}

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const somalia = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017')
      .filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Somalia'))
      .geometry();
    const scale = 5000;
    const april2019Start = '2019-04-01';
    const may2019Start = '2019-05-01';
    const climStart = '1981-01-01';
    const climEnd = '2025-01-01';

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check (primary: ERA5-Land DAILY)
    let datasetName = 'ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/DAILY';
    let bandName = 'volumetric_soil_water_layer_1';
    let col = ee.ImageCollection(datasetName).select(bandName);

    let col2019 = col.filterDate(april2019Start, may2019Start).filterBounds(somalia);
    let size2019 = await getInfoAsync(col2019.size());
    if (size2019 === 0) {
      // Fallback to GLDAS monthly
      datasetName = 'NASA/GLDAS/V021/NOAH/G025/M';
      bandName = 'SoilMoi00_10cm_inst';
      col = ee.ImageCollection(datasetName).select(bandName);
      col2019 = col.filterDate(april2019Start, may2019Start).filterBounds(somalia);
      size2019 = await getInfoAsync(col2019.size());
      if (size2019 === 0) {
        console.log('April 2019 Images: 0');
        console.log('Fallback failed: 0 images.');
        console.log('C1');
        return;
      }
    }

    let climCol = col
      .filterDate(climStart, climEnd)
      .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(4, 4, 'month'))
      .filter(ee.Filter.not(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2019, 2019, 'year')))
      .filterBounds(somalia);

    let sizeClim = await getInfoAsync(climCol.size());
    if (sizeClim === 0) {
      console.log(`April 2019 Images: ${size2019}`);
      console.log('Climatology April Images: 0');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // 3. Processing (compute means and valid pixel counts)
    const img2019 = col2019.mean();
    const imgClim = climCol.mean();

    const stats2019 = ee.Dictionary(
      img2019.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}),
        geometry: somalia,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      })
    );
    const statsClim = ee.Dictionary(
      imgClim.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}),
        geometry: somalia,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      })
    );

    const mean2019 = await getInfoAsync(stats2019.get(bandName));
    const count2019 = await getInfoAsync(stats2019.get(`${bandName}_count`));
    const meanClim = await getInfoAsync(statsClim.get(bandName));
    const countClim = await getInfoAsync(statsClim.get(`${bandName}_count`));

    // 4. Validation & Final Answer
    console.log(`Dataset: ${datasetName}`);
    console.log(`April 2019 Images: ${size2019}`);
    console.log(`Climatology April Images (excl. 2019): ${sizeClim}`);

    if (!count2019 || !countClim || count2019 === 0 || countClim === 0) {
      console.log('Valid Pixels 2019/Clim: ' + (count2019 || 0) + '/' + (countClim || 0));
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }
    if (mean2019 == null || meanClim == null || !isFinite(mean2019) || !isFinite(meanClim)) {
      console.log('Mean 2019/Clim: ' + mean2019 + '/' + meanClim);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }
    // Expected physical range check (0–1 m3/m3 for volumetric soil water content)
    if (mean2019 < 0 || mean2019 > 1 || meanClim < 0 || meanClim > 1) {
      console.log(`Out-of-range values. Mean2019=${mean2019}, MeanClim=${meanClim}`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const diff = mean2019 - meanClim;
    const pct = (diff / meanClim) * 100.0;
    console.log(`2019 Mean (m3/m3): ${mean2019.toFixed(3)}, Pixels: ${count2019}`);
    console.log(`Climatology Mean (m3/m3): ${meanClim.toFixed(3)}, Pixels: ${countClim}`);
    console.log(`Diff (2019 - Clim): ${diff.toFixed(3)} (${pct.toFixed(1)}%)`);

    // Final decision: Is 2019 lower than climatology?
    if (mean2019 < meanClim) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log('Error: ' + err);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
